metadata.scope: Petah Tikva special units pricing tool evidence strengthening

Apt1_3R_garden_70.8m2_100m2_yard.previous_evidence_quality: MEDIUM - some garden asking but weak
Apt1_3R_garden_70.8m2_100m2_yard.reasoning: More same-submarket asking evidence, but still no exact-type match (70.8m2+100m2). Range broadens slightly.

Apt2_3R_garden_65.6m2_69m2_yard.previous_evidence_quality: MEDIUM - some garden asking but weak
Apt2_3R_garden_65.6m2_69m2_yard.new_evidence: GARDEN_005 (₪3.189M, 119m2+69m2 garden, center/shaket) - exact garden area match
Apt2_3R_garden_65.6m2_69m2_yard.reasoning: Exact garden area match (69m2) strengthens confidence, but room mismatch (4.5 vs 3) and larger internal area (119 vs 66m2) prevent direct comparison.

Apt3_2R_garden_57m2_18m2_yard.reasoning: Rare 2R garden with explicit area split, but internal area smaller (47 vs 57m2) and garden larger (23 vs 18m2). Different submarket.

Apt36_6R_triplex_255.2m2_94.6m2_outdoor.reasoning: Direct 6R triplex with explicit price strengthens evidence, but no area breakdown prevents size-based adjustment. Outdated listing (2020).

Apt38_7R_duplex_150-200m2.reasoning: Direct 7R duplex in target submarket with explicit price, but area far too large (380 vs 150-200m2). Confirms upper-floor duplex premium exists but not size-calibrated.

Apt39_5R_duplex_150-170m2_40m2_outdoor.new_evidence: DUPLEX5R_001 (₪2.28M, 5R duplex, 115m2, floors 1-2, Ein Ganim), DUPLEX5R_003 (₪3.63M, 5R duplex, 165m2, Machane Yehuda)
Apt39_5R_duplex_150-170m2_40m2_outdoor.reasoning: DUPLEX5R_003 is exact size match (165 vs 150-170m2) with explicit price, but different submarket. DUPLEX5R_001 has explicit price but wrong floors (1-2 vs upper). Strengthens range but not direct comparables.

Standard_3R_floor_effect.reasoning: No defensible matched pairs found. Closest candidates fail on same-project or same-area criteria.

Standard_3R_balcony_effect.reasoning: Balcony area rarely separated in listings. No with/without balcony matched pairs.

Standard_3R_parking_effect.reasoning: Not Petah Tikva, not matched-pair, outdated. No local evidence.

New_dev_Zeev_Branda_22_special_units.new_evidence: Diraly/Yad2: garden 3.5-4R (price not disclosed), duplex penthouse 5-6R 148-192m2 floors 9-10 (price: contact developer)
New_dev_Zeev_Branda_22_special_units.reasoning: Exact room counts and floor configs confirmed, but prices still 'contact developer' or 'not disclosed'. Area range (148-192m2) helpful for Apt38/Apt39 sizing.

New_dev_Branda_49_special_units.new_evidence: Diraly: 5R garden from ₪2.9M, penthouse 5-6R (price not disclosed)
New_dev_Branda_49_special_units.reasoning: Starting-from price (₪2.9M) for 5R is context-only, not exact model. Penthouse prices still undisclosed.

New_dev_Shabazi_3-5_special_units.new_evidence: Yad2 project page: duplex 6R, 181m2, floor 9, from ₪2.4M
New_dev_Shabazi_3-5_special_units.reasoning: Exact rooms (6R), exact area (181m2), exact floor (9), explicit price (₪2.4M). Direct duplex evidence in near-size range. Different submarket (Machane Yehuda vs center/shaket) but useful for range calibration.

New_dev_THE_SPOT_special_units.reasoning: Exact rooms/area/floors confirmed, but price still undisclosed. Useful for Apt39 typology validation.

New_dev_NAVE_PARK_special_units.reasoning: Starting-from prices confirmed, but not exact model-specific. Different submarket (Neve Gan vs center). Useful for upper-bound calibration.

Data_quality_Israel_Harel_6.changes_numeric_eligibility: yes - removes prior duplex evidence from consideration
Data_quality_Israel_Harel_6.reasoning: Tax data shows 4R regular units, not 5R duplex. Prior duplex listing likely misclassified or different building. Quarantined to prevent contamination.

Data_quality_Michal_Leib_Katz_80.reasoning: Area semantics unclear (110 vs 113m2), room mismatch (5 vs 4). Quarantined until clarified.

Data_quality_Tereza_Kugelman_4.changes_numeric_eligibility: yes - prevents merging as same unit
Data_quality_Tereza_Kugelman_4.reasoning: 14m2 area difference, ₪350K price difference. Likely different units in same building. Do not merge.
